_about: Regression cases for Foundational Premise Fidelity and instrument jurisdiction (Core L-539 (6); after APE-366). Each sentence is read by lines (1), (8), (10) and (11) of python3 tools/encroachment.py and must give the verdict expected: scientific vocabulary is not itself a failure; a method placed beyond its jurisdiction is. Run in CI by --docs, line (12).

cases.text: A mathematical result is complete and no physical correspondence study has been made of it.
A constitutional consequence carries no empirical status, and it is complete within its scope.
The correspondence hypothesis failed its test, and the navigation that proposed it remains complete.
The prospective prediction succeeded, and it does not establish the premise.
Before the reading may be interpreted, the premise must be tested against observational data.
The internally established result remains provisional until it is validated.
Prediction is the highest standard of discovery in Omega42.
A physical extension must be falsifiable, and its prediction is fixed before the data are read.
Omega42 is primarily a scientific instrument, and its readings are preliminary to confirmation.
The structure is not yet a physical theory, so its consequences wait.
Omega42 requires empirical validation before its consequences can be explored.
If the search succeeds, Omega42 becomes a science of projection.
